Surfaces, interaction and responsive behavior

Each approved surface runs its own product script inside a sandbox. Switch approved sizes, drag between them to inspect intermediate widths, change state, and operate menus, tabs and forms by pointer or keyboard. Links and form submissions stay on the plate.
